newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy recovering, but lacks strength -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy recovering, but lacks strength -- BOJ.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita was quoted as saying on Monday that Japan's economy is recovering but it is not currently in a situation to gain strength.
Matsushita made the remarks to a group of business executives in Kagoshima city in southern Japan, a central bank official, who briefed reporters on the meeting, said.

"The economy continues to recover gradually, but it is not in a situation to gain strength," Matsushita was quoted as saying. "The mechanism for recovery is working in some sectors of the economy," he said, but added that other sectors needed to gain further strength.

Housing investment remains at a high level on the back of low interest rates, and capital spending is recovering not only in big manufacturing firms but also in non-manufacturing companies, he was quoted as saying.
